cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, introspective atmosphere that gradually builds into a reassuring and empowering anthem.
cards.vocal: A solo female vocalist delivers the performance with a smooth, warm, and resonant timbre.
cards.palette: A grand piano serves as the harmonic backbone throughout the entire track, playing arpeggiated chords in the verses and shifting to fuller, block chords during the choruses to drive the emotional intensity.
